ORACLE DEPTH MAP (same camera pose and field of view as Oracle RGB):
Colors encode camera-forward distance (z-depth), not object color. Red/orange is nearer, green is intermediate, and blue/purple is farther; black means missing depth, not a nearby surface. This image's color scale runs from 1.318 m (near/red) to 10.772 m (far/purple), with values outside this range clipped. Combine this map with the numbered images and Oracle RGB.
